name: UN Comtrade public preview: US monthly exports of soybeans (HS 1201) and maize/corn (HS 1005) to World
source: UN Comtrade Database (United Nations Statistics Division), public preview API (no key)
source_url: https://comtradeapi.un.org/public/v1/preview/C/M/HS?reporterCode=842&period=202301&cmdCode=1201&flowCode=X&partnerCode=0 (pattern; one request per commodity-month, 44 months x 2 codes = 88 requests, e.g. ...&period=202608&cmdCode=1005...)
license: UN Comtrade terms of use: free for non-commercial use with attribution; no re-sale; public preview used without an API key or subscription; premium API limits apply above the free tier

commodities.1201: Soya beans, whether or not broken (HS 1201)

unit: primary_value_usd in USD (FOB export value); net_weight_kg in kg (net weight)
frequency: monthly (public preview, freqCode=M; exactly one period per request)
coverage: 2023-01 .. 2026-08; 88 monthly observations (44 months x 2 HS codes); United States (reporter 842) exports to World (partner 0); no destination breakdown
notes: Compact public aggregate: monthly US customs export value and net weight for two HS codes, partner World only. Raw API responses (88 monthly JSON files, 85,304 B) were kept in a temporary directory outside the repository and are NOT committed; only this CSV is. The monthly preview returns null descriptive fields (reporterDesc/partnerDesc/cmdDesc), so the CSV keeps codes only and the labels above are static. isReported=false in every monthly row (API flag; values used as returned, no adjustment). Monthly values sum exactly to the annual API totals for 2023, 2024 and 2025 for both HS codes (cross-check in annual_cross_check; 0.0% difference), which is the main internal consistency evidence. Frequency is MONTHLY, not weekly: this replaces the FAS export-sales series only at a monthly horizon; FAS weekly commitments/outstanding sales and destination detail are NOT available here. No PIT/vintages: one current preview snapshot, US/Comtrade revisions may alter historical months; 2026-09 returned no records on 2026-11-26 (data lag). No re-sale; attribution to UN Comtrade/UNSD required. This is not the full Comtrade database. One monthly record (HS 1005, 2025-08) has primaryValue but a null netWgt in the public preview; net_weight_kg is left EMPTY for that row (no imputation).
